purpose: SBOM license metadata review and founder approval for BR-11 publication

summary.approval_basis: 99/106 components have declared license metadata. All 99 matched components use permissive or accepted open-source licenses: MIT (40), Apache 2.0 (28), BSD (22), ISC (2), MPL 2.0 (1), PSFL/PSF-2.0 (2), Unlicense (1), MIT-CMU (1). 2 AGPL-3.0 components (pymupdf, pymupdfb) are accepted — they are the PDF rendering engine, backend-only usage. 7 version-mismatch components have no local metadata (expected for CPU torch wheels not published to PyPI). Standard obligations: keep copyright notices, include Apache 2.0 notice for python-doctr, comply with AGPL-3.0 source distribution requirement for pymupdf.

copyleft_components.name: pymupdf
copyleft_components.rationale: Accepted — core PDF rendering dependency, backend-only usage

copyleft_components.name: pymupdfb
copyleft_components.rationale: Accepted — binary bundle of pymupdf, same dependency chain
